pattern.causal_structure: Multi-level branching architecture enables maximized contact area under surface proximity, producing amplified intermolecular forces that yield reversible dry adhesion.
constraints: terminal elements must reach nanoscale dimensions
fibrous elements must exhibit mechanical compliance
adhesion scales with real contact area
failure_conditions: insufficient normal force for conformal contact
pattern.abstract_principle: Hierarchical branching structures maximize effective contact area to amplify weak intermolecular forces into strong, reversible adhesion without chemical bonding.
